key_insight: Infrastructure as Code can rapidly deploy governed clinical AI services in hospital cloud environments, making bedside-accessible AI more practical.
clinical_relevance: This approach could help hospitals launch privacy-compliant AI tools for clinicians through a browser or API without installing workstation software.
method: Encoded secure backend, private model endpoint, and identity/access setup as machine-readable infrastructure files
Deployed a hospital-governed LLM service in a tertiary care center
Built and tested an LLM-based inconsistency checker for clinical documents
evidence_signal: Deployment took a mean of 310.3 ± 196.6 seconds across 25 runs, and the inconsistency checker flagged severe issues in 105 of 1,347 documents with a population-weighted PPV of 98.2% after audit.
watch_item: Results come from a single-center case study, so broader generalizability and local regulatory integration still need validation.
paper_title: Introducing Infrastructure as Code for deployment and governance of medical AI: A case study
